response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS k, COUNT(*) AS n FROM transactionrecord r JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), s AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS a, SUM(n) AS tot FROM c) SELECT c.k AS tradekind, c.n AS trader_type_count, c.n * 1.0 / s.tot AS share_of_total, c.n - s.a AS diff_from_average FROM c, s WHERE s.a IS NOT NULL AND c.n > s.a
